observations: PRED-281.H5 reconstructs a 'lost fourth stanza' of Sappho 31 (falsifier: future papyrological discoveries), while PRED-503.H4, PRED-1476.H3 and PRED-1478.H3 hold that the transmitted end is not damage but the completed poem. Apparent contradiction, recorded as observation; the erratum chain may carry it as deliberate structure.

PRED-858.H1 (2026-06-18) cites 'μολπὰ γράμμασι ζώοι ("may my song survive in letters")' as Sappho's prayer and the earliest statement of inscription survival, without hypothesis marking; the phrase resembles the reconstructed Adonic 'γράμμασι μολπὰν' of PRED-281.H5, which #281 marks as hypothesis. A later pass should check whether #858's phrase derives from the reconstruction (lines 77 and 133 of #858 located, not read).

PRED-1423.F1 holds that an instrument's continued non-adoption is a standing datum, while PRED-1540.F4 holds that mere non-response 'receives no evidentiary weight'. Apparent contradiction between two reception-as-measurement claims (series 'Reception as measurement').

PRED-1605.G1 says the failure to separate the Aristotle/Theophrastus names 'is a property of the configuration, not a limitation of the method', while PRED-1605.F15 (same deposit) says the instrument that would deserve the word authorship has not been built, and PRED-1593.G1 states 'No supervised separation licenses an inference to distinct makers'. Apparent tension, recorded as observation; PRED-1593.G1 and PRED-1605.G1 were left unlinked.

PRED-1654.H2 (group TP03.2) concerns the founding work 'I Am X, Be Y, Blessed is the Z' (#328) and the Prince of Poets mantle; PRED-83.H1 and PRED-83.E3 are registered in deposit 83, titled 'I Am X… Be Y… Blessed Is the Z… The Prophetic Catalog'. A later pass may link them once the relation of deposit 83 to #328 is checked.

PRED-1426.G1 (group TP03.1) and PRED-1426.B1 (group TP03.2) are two claims of one deposit (CERN's Destruction of the Crimson Hexagon) split across groups: what deletion erases is the instrument; what is rebuilt will be a different poem. Left unlinked.

PRED-1494.G6 and PRED-1532.H4 may belong with Sappho 31 Philo/occlusion claims in other batches; PRED-1474.H3, 1476.H3 and 1478.H3 are links in the Sappho 31 erratum chain whose other members (e.g. the otium claim) may sit in other batches.
